observed_anchors.claim: The accepted-target productive /usr/bin/python3 SQLite path resolves to SQLite 3.45.1 and the V5 root trust anchor is absent.
observed_anchors.evidence: gschaidergabriel/Dr.-Unterweger run 31527030989; artifact 9115325241; research re-entry ccb196bc7ae8907d492aa2de5bdc6709cdfac91c

observed_anchors.claim: Current main V5 launcher fixes inherited PATH before helper execution but begins as /bin/sh and does not establish a pre-dynamic-loader environment boundary before the shell process starts.

generated_reality.hypothesis: The V5 shell launcher plus the Python V5/V4/V2 loader checks are sufficient as a standalone fail-closed trust boundary even when process loader environment variables are inherited from an untrusted launch context.
generated_reality.mechanism_if_right: The launcher or guard would reject or sanitize untrusted loader state before any untrusted code can execute.

counter_reality.hypothesis: The ELF dynamic loader processes LD_PRELOAD before /bin/sh or /usr/bin/python3 can execute launcher/guard code, so a caller-controlled launch environment can cause code execution before V5 reaches its fail-closed checks.
counter_reality.predicted_observation: A harmless preload constructor produces a run-owned marker even though the V5 launcher subsequently exits 78 because the production root anchor is absent.

single_bounded_unusual_experiment.replication_model: One experiment class measured locally first and then replicated on the accepted self-hosted Ubuntu target; replication does not count as a second unusual experiment.
single_bounded_unusual_experiment.scope: harmless constructor writes only a marker under run-owned /tmp; no production or canonical state mutation

baseline.expected: exit 78 because V5 root anchor is absent; no marker

intervention.launch: /bin/sh current V5 launcher with LD_PRELOAD pointing at a run-owned harmless constructor library
intervention.expected_if_counter_reality_right: constructor marker appears before launcher fail-closed exit 78

collapse.scope_caveat: This experiment does not prove that a production token/API caller can set the service process environment. It proves that the current shell/Python admission chain is not itself an independent pre-loader trust boundary when its parent launch context permits loader-environment control.

relationship_to_existing_counterevidence.distinction: That record demonstrates a post-hash mutable SQLite runtime-object replacement before final V1 denial. This record demonstrates pre-launch dynamic-loader execution before the shell/Python V5 checks. They are separate trust-boundary failure classes and neither should erase the other.

architecture_delta.change: Treat the trusted parent launch environment as part of SQLite/runtime admission. Positive production acceptance must prove that the exact service launch path establishes a non-user-controlled loader environment before any dynamic shell/Python process starts, or use an earlier launch mechanism that cannot execute caller-selected dynamic-loader code before admission.
implementation_candidates: Owner-controlled service manager configuration with exact ExecStart, explicit sanitized environment, no request-derived environment mutation, and attested unit/config identity.
A minimal earlier launcher whose own code-loading boundary is independently trusted and measured rather than assuming an interpreted shell/Python wrapper can sanitize pre-exec loader state.
architecture_delta.not_promoted: No implementation candidate is verified by this experiment.
required_falsifiers: On the accepted target, inject the same harmless LD_PRELOAD marker into every legitimately reachable service-start/restart path and prove it cannot execute before V5 admission.
Prove production API/request/tool/web data cannot influence process launch environment or service-manager environment.
Repeat positive fixed-SQLite V5 admission, restart, downgrade, library-swap and rollback tests after legitimate root anchor/runtime provisioning.

negative_results_preserved: Current productive target remains on SQLite 3.45.1 and lacks the V5 root trust anchor.
V4 caller-selected manifest/digest is not independent deployment authority.
A mutable V1 candidate runtime can be loaded after replacement before final active-hash denial in the separate post-hash counterworld.
Current V5 shell/Python chain cannot retroactively prevent LD_PRELOAD constructor execution that occurs before its own code runs when the parent launch environment is untrusted.
next_falsifier: Bind and attest the exact production service-launch parent/environment, then rerun this pre-exec loader experiment through the real service start/restart path alongside positive fixed-runtime V5 admission.
